questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one that appears on screen and in my notes?
What is the business or brand called?
What is your main handle, and on which platform do you post most?
In one sentence: what do you help people with, and who are they?
What is your accent colour (the one colour used for the key word, the focal element and the glow)?
(saved with the accent colour) the plain word for it: blue, gold, lime
Which font do you use for headlines?
(found on their computer) the bold weight of the main font
(found on their computer) the regular or medium weight of the main font; left unset, the bold is reused
Do you want key words in a second, contrasting font, or the same font in your colour?
(found on their computer) the emphasis font; the shipped Playfair Display Italic if they have no preference
Transcribe with ElevenLabs (recommended, the most accurate word timings) or on this computer (free)?
Where should finished videos go? Next to the raw file in an '- Edit' folder is the default.
questions.default: beside the raw file, in a "<video name> - Edit" folder

questions.ask: Is your raw footage on an external drive? Which one?
Where do you keep the real things I can show on screen: client results, screenshots, reel covers?
Besides your proof folder, are there other folders I should search for real things to show: client work, brand assets, reel covers, screenshots?
When a panel names a company, a person, a website or a video, may I fetch the real logo, photo, screenshot or thumbnail from the web? Rights are yours to manage; I list every source.
questions.default: yes: real over drawn, every source listed in the report

questions.ask: Is there anything that must never be shown on screen: names, clients, competitors, figures, old offers, topics?
If you do not tell me which parts of a reel should be full screen, should I pick one to three short, punchy moments and tell you which, or add none?
questions.default: pick 1 to 3 short moments and tell me which

questions.ask: What do you usually ask viewers to do at the end of a reel: comment a keyword, follow, a link in your bio, or something else?
Should your name appear, faint, on the final call-to-action panel only?
If I tighten silences on a cut when you ask, what is the shortest pause I should treat as a silence, in seconds? 0.32 is tight but natural.
Should I render a quick 720p preview and wait for your yes before the final render?
questions.default: yes: a 720p preview first, the final after approval

questions.ask: Should I run the whole reel to the end and then report (the sections, the full-screen picks, every invented line), or stop and ask after the section plan and after the preview?
questions.default: run to the end, then report
